--- Page 2 ---
The Problem
Manual document handling is slow, error-prone, and completely unscalable for modern
workflows.
Unstructured Documents
PDFs, scans, and images each require manual reading and tedious data re-entry.
Time-Consuming
Hours spent extracting tables and text that a machine could handle in seconds.
Error-Prone
Human transcription introduces costly mistakes in critical financial and legal data.
Not Searchable
Scanned PDFs are image-only impossible to copy, search, or index
programmatically.
--- Page 3 ---

One upload. Automatic extraction of everything text, tables, and images from any document type.
